subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear John, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris on June 15th. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Departure: June 15th, 10:00 AM Arrival: June 15th, 2:00 PM Seat: 15A Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
